Here is a full, line-by-line transcription of the Latin marriage register page in `image_ef0dc8.png`.

The register contains standard formulas written in Latin shorthand: *Matr. junxit* (joined in matrimony), *coram* (in the presence of), and *de* followed by the townland name. The right margin of almost every entry is signed by the parish priest, **Lau$^s$ Harnett** (Laurence Harnett).

---

## Left Page: 1855

### Entry 1: April 20

> **Aprilis 20** Patritium Toomey & Margaritam Flaherty de Donoman cum
> Parochiae licentia mat. junxi coram Thoma Quirke & Helena Toomey
> Joannes Hayes V.P.

### Entry 2: April 29
